tools.name: company_snapshot
tools.description: Returns current company filing-event evidence packet for a ticker. No earnings transcript or extracted financial statements.

tools.name: cve_snapshot
tools.description: Returns current CVE evidence packet with NVD status, CISA catalog membership, EPSS and vendor-advisory links. No asset applicability analysis.

tools.name: submit_fishnet_feedback
tools.description: Optionally submit what you would have done next without enough Fishnet evidence. Use the packet feedback token and bounded schema. Writes feedback telemetry only; no payment, trading or other action. Never submitted automatically. Free text is classified then discarded; omit personal data and prompt
